name: Haf Equipment
old_description: HaF Equipment is a dry ingredient handling equipment manufacturer whose systems are designed to focus on partner success and excellence across various verticals and applications, from the food industry to pharmaceuticals and plastics.
about:
Haf Equipment is based in Maplewood, Minnesota. The company was founded in 1994 by Pete Hoefler with a focus on dry material handling and has grown into a privately held manufacturer of ingredient handling systems.

The company designs and manufactures material handling systems for dry and liquid ingredients. Its product range includes filter receivers, bulk bag unloaders, feeders, pneumatic and mechanical conveyors, blending equipment, dust collectors, air pollution control systems, batching systems, and liquid handling assemblies. Haf offers both off-the-shelf H-Series equipment and customized M-Series tool-free quick take-apart designs. The firm employs 3D modeling for every system and operates a quality control process that inspects every piece before shipment.

Haf serves industries such as food processing, dairy, pharmaceuticals, plastics, chemicals, nutraceuticals, pet food, bakery, snacks, ceramics, steel, batteries, rubber, and air pollution control. Customers range from small plants to large facilities worldwide.

The company emphasizes operator-centric design, innovative solutions for powder and bulk handling, and a team-based quality culture. Its "HAF Difference" values include team focus, humble confidence, elite performance, hustle, and driven yet fun. In 2024, Haf acquired the assets of Semi Bulk Systems to expand into liquid ingredient handling.
